# Components

Read [the general rules](rules.md) once, then only the page of each component you use. The full list, as data, is in [`catalog.json`](catalog.json).

## Actions

| Component | Status | Use |
|---|---|---|
| [`button`](button.md) | approved | Use buttons to start actions. |
| [`confirmation-dialog`](confirmation-dialog.md) | available | Asks before an action that cannot be undone, and names what will be lost. |
| [`dropdown`](dropdown.md) | available | A dropdown can open a menu or another element when the user clicks the button. |
| [`fab`](fab.md) | available | A FAB is a floating action button that stays in a bottom corner of the screen. It contains a focusable, accessible element with a button role. When the user clicks or focuses it, more speed-dial buttons appear. These buttons have a vertical or quarter-circle arrangement. |
| [`modal`](modal.md) | available | A modal shows a dialog or box when the user clicks a button. |
| [`swap`](swap.md) | available | Use the swap component to change the visibility of two elements. Control the swap with a checkbox or a class name. |
| [`theme-controller`](theme-controller.md) | available | If a checked checkbox or radio input has the `theme-controller` class, the page uses the theme in the input value. |

## Data display

| Component | Status | Use |
|---|---|---|
| [`accordion`](accordion.md) | available | Use the accordion to show and hide content. Only one item can be open at a time. |
| [`avatar`](avatar.md) | available | Use an avatar to show a thumbnail image. |
| [`badge`](badge.md) | available | Use a badge to show the status of data. |
| [`board`](board.md) | available | Cards in columns, each with a form that moves it, and dragging for a pointer or a finger. |
| [`card`](card.md) | approved | Use cards to group and show content. |
| [`carousel`](carousel.md) | available | Use a carousel to show images or content in a scrollable area. |
| [`chart`](chart.md) | available | A figure with its text summary and its data as a table, drawn with Chart.js. |
| [`chat`](chat.md) | available | A chat bubble shows one line of a conversation and its related data. This data can include the author image, name, and time. |
| [`collapse`](collapse.md) | available | Use the collapse component to show and hide content. |
| [`countdown`](countdown.md) | available | A countdown gives a transition effect when a number changes from 0 through 999. |
| [`description-list`](description-list.md) | available | A list of terms and their values, for one record's details. |
| [`diff`](diff.md) | decorative | Use the diff component to show a side-by-side comparison of two items. |
| [`event-calendar`](event-calendar.md) | available | Events by month, week or agenda, drawn by FullCalendar, each a link to its form. |
| [`gantt`](gantt.md) | available | A table and, beside it, the same rows as bars on a calendar, drawn on the server. |
| [`hover-3d`](hover-3d.md) | decorative | The hover 3D component is a wrapper that adds a 3D effect to its content. When the pointer is on the component, the component tilts and turns in relation to the pointer position. |
| [`hover-gallery`](hover-gallery.md) | decorative | A hover gallery is a container for images. The first image is visible by default. When the pointer moves horizontally on it, the other images appear. Use a hover gallery for product cards, e-commerce sites, portfolios, or image galleries. A hover gallery can contain a maximum of 10 images. |
| [`icon`](icon.md) | available | Any of Lucide's icons, or one of the organization's, hidden from screen readers. |
| [`kbd`](kbd.md) | available | Use the kbd component to show keyboard shortcuts. |
| [`list`](list.md) | available | Use a list to show information in rows in a vertical layout. |
| [`stat`](stat.md) | available | Use a stat component to show numbers and data in a block. |
| [`status`](status.md) | available | A status is a small icon that shows the current state of an element. Example states are online, offline, and error. |
| [`table`](table.md) | available | Use a table to show data in rows and columns. |
| [`text-rotate`](text-rotate.md) | problems | Text rotate can show a maximum of six text lines, one line at a time. It uses a continuous loop animation. The default animation time is 10 seconds. The animation pauses when the pointer is on the text. |
| [`timeline`](timeline.md) | available | Use a timeline to show a list of events in chronological order. |

## Navigation

| Component | Status | Use |
|---|---|---|
| [`breadcrumbs`](breadcrumbs.md) | available | Use breadcrumbs to help users navigate. |
| [`dock`](dock.md) | available | A dock is also called bottom navigation or a bottom bar. It gives navigation options and stays at the bottom of the screen. |
| [`link`](link.md) | available | The link component adds an underline to links. |
| [`menu`](menu.md) | available | Use a menu to show a list of links vertically or horizontally. |

| [`pagination`](pagination.md) | available | Pagination is a group of buttons. |
| [`steps`](steps.md) | available | Use the steps component to show a sequence in a process. |
| [`tab`](tab.md) | available | Use tabs to show a list of links in a tabbed format. |

| Component | Status | Use |
|---|---|---|

## Data input

| Component | Status | Use |
|---|---|---|
| [`calendar`](calendar.md) | problems | The calendar component includes styles for different calendar libraries. |
| [`checkbox`](checkbox.md) | available | Use a checkbox to select or deselect a value. |
| [`date-field`](date-field.md) | available | The browser's own date field, read by the server in one strict form. |
| [`error-summary`](error-summary.md) | available | Every problem of a form in one place, each a link to its field. |
| [`field-error`](field-error.md) | available | What is wrong with one field, and how to fix it, tied to that field. |
| [`fieldset`](fieldset.md) | available | Use a fieldset as a container for related form elements. Use `fieldset-legend` as the title. Use `label` as the description. |
| [`file-input`](file-input.md) | available | Use a file input to upload files. |
| [`filter`](filter.md) | available | A filter is a group of radio buttons. When the user selects an option, the filter hides the other options. It also shows a reset button next to the selected option. |
| [`filter-bar`](filter-bar.md) | available | A plain form that filters a list on the server. daisyUI's filter is a set of radio buttons. |
| [`filter-panel`](filter-panel.md) | available | The same form in a side panel that can be hidden, for a list with many filters. |
| [`form-actions`](form-actions.md) | available | The main action of a form, the way out, and anything else at the far end. |
| [`input`](input.md) | available | Use a text input as a simple input field. |
| [`label`](label.md) | available | Use a label to give a name or title to an input field. Put the label before or after the field. |
| [`number-field`](number-field.md) | available | Text a person types as their language writes numbers. Never a float. |
| [`otp`](otp.md) | available | An OTP is a one-time password component that lets a user enter a verification code. The code usually contains four to six digits. Use it for two-factor authentication (2FA) or passwordless login. |
| [`radio`](radio.md) | available | Use radio buttons to let the user select one option. |
| [`range`](range.md) | available | Move a range-slider handle to select a value. |
| [`rating`](rating.md) | available | A rating is a set of radio buttons that lets the user give a rating. |
| [`searchable-select`](searchable-select.md) | available | A list to type in, by keyboard, that is a plain select without JavaScript. |
| [`select`](select.md) | available | Use a select component to select a value from a list of options. |
| [`textarea`](textarea.md) | available | A textarea lets users enter text on more than one line. |
| [`toggle`](toggle.md) | available | A toggle is a checkbox with the style of a switch button. |
| [`validator`](validator.md) | available | The validator class sets an error color or a success color on a form element. The input validation rules control the color. |

## Layout

| Component | Status | Use |
|---|---|---|
| [`aura`](aura.md) | decorative | An aura adds a light effect around the border of a component. Use it to make an important button, card, or div easy to see. |
| [`divider`](divider.md) | available | Use a divider to separate content vertically or horizontally. |
| [`drawer`](drawer.md) | problems | A drawer is a grid layout that can show and hide a sidebar. The sidebar can be on either side of the page. |
| [`footer`](footer.md) | available | A footer can contain a logo, a copyright notice, and links to other pages. |
| [`hero`](hero.md) | available | Use a hero to show a large box or image with a title and description. |
| [`indicator`](indicator.md) | available | Use an indicator to put an element at the corner of another element. |
| [`join`](join.md) | available | A join is a container that groups more than one item. Use it to group buttons, inputs, or other elements. The join applies a border radius to the first and last items. It can make a horizontal or vertical list of items. |
| [`mask`](mask.md) | decorative | A mask crops the content of an element to a common shape. |
| [`megamenu`](megamenu.md) | available | A megamenu is a large horizontal menu. Each item opens a popover that shows a large group of navigation links. Use one megamenu at the top of the page. Each popover can contain a daisyUI menu or custom content. Use a megamenu on large screens. On small screens, hide it and show its content in a dropdown or drawer. |
| [`stack`](stack.md) | available | A stack puts elements on top of each other. |
